subject: Hosted baseline pricing & Dedicated/Private crosswalk — rate request
messages:
From: Marcelle Dupont <m.dupont@olivetech.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@olivetech.com>, Oliver Park <oliver.park@olivetech.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: baseline hosted pricing + crosswalk to Dedicated/Private

Hi Connor,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — OliveTech liked the throughput and the latency profile on shorter sequences. Procurement asked me to get a concrete baseline rate card for the hosted API (we need per-1k-token figures for both prompt and completion tokens), and then a concise cross-walk that explains how those numbers change if we move to Redwood Dedicated or Redwood Private.

Specific asks:
- Hosted: baseline per-1k token (prompt/completion) and any minimums/quotas.
- Dedicated: expected % discount at 3/6/12 month committed spend levels, and whether there are per-GPU or per-node billing metrics.
- Private: one-time platform/license fees, recurring support/maintenance, and whether infra is included or billed separately.
- Any typical professional services (onboarding) fees and a sense of lead times.

We've attached a short workbook with our projected token volumes by quarter. Can you send a short cross-walk and an initial commercial summary we can share with procurement?

Appreciate it — Marcelle
Procurement Lead, OliveTech

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcelle Dupont <m.dupont@olivetech.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@olivetech.com>, Oliver Park <oliver.park@olivetech.com>, aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 16 Oct 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: baseline hosted pricing + crosswalk to Dedicated/Private

Hi Marcelle — good to hear the demo landed well. I attached a short two-page cross-walk and a high-level commercial summary that maps hosted baseline to Dedicated and Private. Highlights here in the body for quick review:

- Hosted baseline (no commitment): $0.006 / 1k prompt tokens, $0.008 / 1k completion tokens. No minimum; standard rate-limited tiers apply.
- Dedicated: typically ~25–40% discount off hosted list depending on committed monthly spend and term. Minimum committed monthly spend for a Dedicated pool is usually $40k/month for single-pool customers; multi-pool/enterprise pricing varies. Dedicated is billed as reserved capacity (monthly).
- Private (VPC/on-prem): one-time platform license + deployment fee (~$250k typical for mid-sized deployments) + annual platform fee (examples: $120k/year) + infra costs (customer-owned or cloud marketplace bill) and optional support tiers. Private often also incurs an initial professional services onboarding fee ($30–80k depending on scope).

I added notes on overage handling for Dedicated (overages billed at hosted list less the committed discount) and on SLA tiers. See attachments: OliveTech_Rate_Request.xlsx (your file), Hosted_vs_Dedicated_Pricing_Summary.pdf, Commercial_Summary_v2.pdf (draft).

Can we schedule a 30-min procurement call tomorrow to walk procurement through the cross-walk? I can include Aditya (pricing lead) if helpful.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Fwd: Request: baseline hosted pricing + crosswalk to Dedicated/Private — internal pricing notes

Laura / Aditya — looping you both for pricing sign-off and negotiation approach. Quick internal summary of our suggested posture for OliveTech:

- Hosted baseline: list in email above. We should treat this as the default reference price.
- Dedicated: we can offer a 30% discount at 6-9 month 250k+ TCV commits, up to 40% at 12+ month 500k+ TCV. Standard language: reserved capacity billed monthly; overages billed at list less agreed discount.
- Private: do not discount platform license heavily — platform license + PS recovers fixed costs. Offer 10–15% off annual platform fee for multi-year commitments.
- Add-ons: SLA/uptime guarantees and extended observability retention are priced as line items. Recommend including a 90-day pilot at hosted rates with a short-term credit toward Dedicated if they convert within 60 days.

Attachment: Commercial_Summary_v2.pdf (draft) — want to make sure we aren't over-exposing discount bands in the commercial summary sent to procurement.

Thoughts? If you approve, I'll send final numbers and the DocuSign link for a draft SOW.

— Connor
(Internal)

Thanks Connor — quick clarifying items from procurement:
- For Dedicated, is the committed spend measured in $ or in GPU/vCPU units? Procurement wants to understand if they can buy an explicit unit (e.g., n GPUs) vs. a dollar commitment.
- For Private, confirm whether the one-time platform license assumption includes the control plane or whether OliveTech must provision and pay for separate cloud infra.
- For discounts: can you outline what triggers a higher discount (volume vs. term vs. exclusivity)?

Also, what's the expected lead time for a Dedicated pool (standard) vs. Private on a cloud region? Procurement is planning their FY26 budget and needs timelines.

Thanks — Marcelle

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcelle Dupont <m.dupont@olivetech.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 18 Oct 2025 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: baseline hosted pricing + crosswalk to Dedicated/Private — answers and next steps

Hi Marcelle — answers below (pulling in Aditya for pricing confirmation).

1) Dedicated measurement: commitments are expressed as a dollar committed monthly spend for reserved capacity. We can translate committed $ into a recommended GPU pool size (e.g., $40k/mo ≈ 4x A100-80GB-equivalent slots with managed autoscaling) but we do not sell "GPU units" as the invoiced item on standard contracts — it's a committed spend model. We do offer custom contracts that can map to explicit unit counts if procurement requires it.

2) Private / infra: the one-time platform license covers the Redwood control plane software license and deployment services. Cloud compute is separate — OliveTech can choose to bring-your-own-cloud (you pay the cloud provider) or we can provide a marketplace image with estimated infra costs. The example cost in my previous email (one-time ~ $250k; annual platform fee ~$120k) assumes infra is NOT included.

3) Discount triggers: volume (committed TCV) is the primary lever; term length (12+ months) is the secondary lever. We also consider strategic criteria (market reference customer, exclusivity in a vertical, joint case study) for incremental discretion. For OliveTech, a 12-month commitment at $500k+ TCV would justify our top band (~40% off hosted list for Dedicated).

4) Lead times: Dedicated pool provisioning is typically 2–4 weeks after contract signature and deposit. Private deployments (cloud/VPC) are usually 6–12 weeks depending on region and integration complexity; on-prem/offline air-gapped deployments can be longer.

Next steps I propose:
- Connor/Aditya to deliver final commercial summary with precise tiered discounts and wording for overages (by EOD Monday).
- 30-minute procurement call week of Oct 20 to walk through and capture any redlines.
- Draft SOW/DocuSign to follow after procurement alignment.
